title.zh: CFTC 扩大对被动交易软件提供商的监管豁免
title.en: CFTC Expands No-Action Relief for Passive Trading Software Providers

current_state.zh: The CFTC expanded no-action relief for passive trading software providers, enabling crypto wallets and apps to facilitate access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.
current_state.en: The CFTC expanded no-action relief for passive trading software providers, enabling crypto wallets and apps to facilitate access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

updates.title_zh: Regulators keep moving on crypto: CFTC follows SEC with developer-friendly no-action stance
updates.title_en: Regulators keep moving on crypto: CFTC follows SEC with developer-friendly no-action stance
